newsitem.title: UK: OPEC basket price tumbled $1.58 last week to $16.7.
newsitem.headline: OPEC basket price tumbled $1.58 last week to $16.7.

text.p: The price of OPEC's basket of seven crudes fell sharply to $16.78 a barrel last week from $18.36 the previous week, the OPEC news agency said, quoting the OPEC Secretariat.
The price of the basket so far this year to June 12 has averaged $19.42, OPECNA said.
In May the basket price averaged $18.76, versus $17.46 in April and $18.64 in March.
For the first quarter the basket price averaged $20.77, down from $23.06 in the fourth quarter of last year, it said.
The basket comprises Algeria's Saharan Blend, Indonesia's Minas, Nigeria's Bonny Light, Saudi Arabia's Arabian Light, Dubai of the UAE, Venezuela's Tia Juana and Mexico's Isthmus crude.
